summary: Completed frontend testing of enhanced 'Alterar Texto — Todos os Slides' dialog with font family and font size selectors. All 10 features tested. 9/10 PASS, 1 minor UX observation (Apply button enabled initially due to default color value #ffffff - this is by design, 'Limpar' button clears it).

issues: Minor UX: Apply button is enabled on dialog open because color field has default value '#ffffff'. User can click 'Limpar' to clear it. This is by design to show the color picker properly.

critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: Dialog title correctly shows 'Alterar Texto — Todos os Slides'
GOOD: Color picker (data-testid='bulk-text-color-picker') visible and functional
GOOD: Hex input (data-testid='bulk-text-color-hex') visible and functional
GOOD: 'Limpar' button clears color field correctly
GOOD: Font family dropdown (data-testid='bulk-font-family-select') with 21 options (1 default '— Manter fonte atual —' + 20 fonts)
GOOD: Font size dropdown (data-testid='bulk-font-size-select') with 16 options (1 default '— Manter tamanho atual —' + 15 sizes)
GOOD: Font preview text 'O rápido rapaz pula sobre o cão preguiçoso.' appears when font is selected
GOOD: Preview section shows 3 slide thumbnails with applied styles
GOOD: Apply button (data-testid='apply-bulk-text-style') enables when at least one field has value
GOOD: Apply button disables when all fields are empty (after using Limpar)
GOOD: Cancelar button closes dialog correctly
GOOD: Apply button text is 'Aplicar a Todos os Slides'

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk Text Style dialog fully tested. Navigation: Dashboard > click first project > wait for editor to load > click 'Cor do Texto' button in top right bar. Dialog has 3 sections: Cor do Texto (color picker + hex input + preset colors + Limpar button), Fonte (dropdown with 20 fonts), Tamanho do Texto (dropdown with 15 sizes). Font preview text appears when font is selected. Preview section shows 3 slide thumbnails. Apply button enables when at least one field has a value.
